description: Fix 4 issues identified in code review: line chart property mismatch, pie chart property mismatch, ownership TOCTOU race condition, and modal timing assumption.
steps: In apps-script/Code.gs: In getDashboardData(), change lineMap entries from property 'date' to 'data' to match frontend expectations
In apps-script/Code.gs: In getDashboardData(), change pieData return from { retido, cancelado } to { retidos, cancelados } to match frontend expectations
In apps-script/Code.gs: In iniciarAtendimento(), wrap the read-check-write block with LockService.getScriptLock().tryLock(5000) and release in a finally block
In apps-script/Index.html: In iniciarAtendimentoClick(), remove setTimeout approach and instead open modal in loadData success callback by adding optional callback parameter to loadData
acceptance_criteria: lineMap entries use property name 'data' instead of 'date'
lineData.sort() comparator uses a.data instead of a.date
pieData returns { retidos: pieRetido, cancelados: pieCancelado }
iniciarAtendimento uses LockService.getScriptLock() with tryLock(5000) around the read-check-write
iniciarAtendimentoClick does not use setTimeout, instead opens modal in a callback after data reload
verification: Grep for 'data: dateKey' in Code.gs to confirm property renamed
Grep for 'setTimeout' in iniciarAtendimentoClick to confirm it's removed
